National Clean Air Programme (NCAP): Implementation Guidelines & Target Milestones

Division: Air Quality Management & Pollution Control Date: January 10, 2024 Notification No: Q-16017/38/2023-CPA

The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change launched the National Clean Air Programme (NCAP) as a comprehensive long-term national level strategy to tackle air pollution problem across the country.

Target: 40% reduction or achievement of National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS) for PM10 concentration by 2025-26 in 131 non-attainment cities.
